customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be among the best in the market, appreciating its premium appearance, excellent taste, and great water quality that makes a noticeable difference. Moreover, they consider it a budget-friendly option with transparent pricing, and one customer notes its simple installation process. However, the reliability receives mixed feedback, with some customers reporting it functions well while others mention it stops working.

reviews.author: Lavanya.TV
reviews.title: Loved it ☺️
reviews.body: I am very satisfied with this water purifier. The water tastes clean and fresh, and the purifier is easy to use. The design is good, and it works efficiently. Overall, it is a good product and offers good value for money. I would recommend it to others.

reviews.author: Prathamesh
reviews.title: Purifier
reviews.body: Excellent purifier with good build quality I am using the Urban Company Native M1 and overall I am very satisfied with the product. The purifier looks stylish and has a good build quality. The water tastes clean and fresh, and the 8-litre storage capacity is very useful for regular family use. The RO + UV + Alkaline + Mineraliser purification system is a good combination

reviews.author: Iqubal
reviews.title: Water purifier works perfectly and it's installation service was great.
reviews.body: Product is good and am satisfied till now. But long review should be uploaded after few months, I have just bought few few days back.

reviews.author: mahesh kumar
reviews.title: Excellent Product & Superb Service - Totally Worth It! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.body: Native M1 Pro bahut hi badhiya product hai. Delivery ekdum fast hui. Installation Urban Company team ne two days me kar di, technician ka behaviour bahut professional tha. Purifier ka design stylish hai aur paani ka taste ekdum natural aur meetha hai. RO + Copper + Alkaline ki wajah se paani light hai. App me live TDS dekh sakte hai. 2 saal ki warranty ka tension-free feature best hai. Highly satisfied! Thank you team! Loved the Native M1 Pro - Premium look, great water taste, super quick delivery and very professional installation. App monitoring feature is excellent. Very happy customer! 👍

reviews.author: Santosh Nangare
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: "The Native M1 is an amazing water purifier. It has a very sleek and modern design that looks great in the kitchen. The 10-stage filtration gives complete peace of mind about water safety. The taste of the water improved instantly after installation. Great value for money and totally hassle-free!" 👍
